inlines.v: DISCUSSION, noun 1. In surgery, resolution; the dispersion of a tumor or any coagulated matter. 2. Debate; disquisition; the agitation of a point or subject with a view to elicit truth; the treating of a subject by argument, to clear it of difficulties, and separate truth from falsehood.
